releaseNotes:
## Guest Inbox

- Replies sent in Outlook show up in the same Guest Inbox thread and clear Needs reply when that reply is the newest message.
- Replies sent in the Booking app are placed in Sent, and the original message is marked answered so Outlook can show it as replied.
- Needs reply still follows the newest message. A later guest email needs a reply again.
- A single sent reply no longer appears twice in the thread.
- Add a signature to new emails and replies from Connections → Email. It is part of the draft, so you can edit it before sending.
- Attach files to outgoing mail. Reusable files are managed under Connections → Email files.

Sent mail handling is under Connections → Email → Advanced. Auto avoids a second Sent copy when the mailbox already stored the message.
